packageInspection.limits: Inspection found no compiled-module injection/cache option or documented startup fix. This is not proof that every possible upstream or browser fix is impossible.

primarySources.finding: Release notes through 2.4.2 contain no documented fix for this initialization delay.
Current upstream still pins WA-SQLite 2.0.3 for SQLite-core compatibility.
Current upstream still invokes the per-open module factory.

inference: The measured delay precedes course repairs. A repair/index optimization or routine package bump has no evidence-backed route to fix this case.

decisionNeeded.recommended: Authorize a bounded investigation of PowerSync worker/module startup reuse within the chosen engine and persistent database, preserving all timing and integrity requirements.
decisionNeeded.reason: Implementing reuse without a supported SDK option changes the engine integration and worker lifetime. AGENTS.md section14 requires escalation for a material change to the chosen stack; no fallback is adopted automatically.
guardrails: Do not change engines, switch to in-memory persistence, or change VFS without a separately reviewed decision.
Do not raise either 5000 ms bound, skip the case, prewarm outside timing, or add retries.
A candidate must prove close/reopen, cross-tab writes and guards, interruption recovery, isolated test storage, and later full reset before adoption.
An upstream/browser runtime fix remains a possible alternative.
No issue or message is sent to maintainers without explicit authorization.

otherBlocker: Three enlarged-text image comparisons remain unresolved. Smoothing and connected-canvas variants failed; no image threshold or production font change adopted.
